blocks.text: Hypotonic solution: aisa mahlool jis mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar se kam ho. Is liye pani osmosis se cell ke andar aata hai aur cell phool jata hai.

Hypertonic solution: aisa mahlool jis mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar se zyada ho. Is liye pani cell se bahar nikalta hai aur pani kam hone se cell sukar jata hai; is halat ko plasmolysis kehte hain.
Isotonic solution: aisa mahlool jis mein solute ki concentration cell ke andar jitni hi ho. Is soorat mein cell aur us ke mahol ke darmiyan pani ki kul (net) harkat zero hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Pode ke teen cells, har ek mein cell wall, nucleus aur vacuole aur do surkh H2O teer. Hypertonic halaat (Plasmolyzed): dono teer bahar, protoplast deewar se hat kar sikur gaya aur vacuole chhota. Isotonic halaat (Flaccid): ek teer bahar ek andar, vacuole darmiyana. Hypotonic halaat (Turgid): dono teer andar, bara vacuole cell ko phooli hui deewar se daba raha hai. Labels: Cell wall, Vacuole.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.16: Hypertonic, hypotonic aur isotonic mahlool ka pode ke cell par asar (kitab ki Figure 8.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ko dekhein: bahar ka mahlool zyada gaarha (hypertonic) ho to pani cell se nikal jata hai aur andar ka hissa sukar jata hai (plasmolysis); barabar (isotonic) ho to pani jitna aata hai utna hi jata hai aur cell dheela (flaccid) rehta hai; patla (hypotonic) ho to pani andar aata hai aur cell tan jata hai (turgid). Cell wall pode ke cell ko phatne nahin deti.
